correctness.rationale: Direct two-one parity classification and exact integer root-offset intervals are necessary/sufficient, all equal-gap collisions are counted, and the positive-composition Dirichlet limit gives mean 5/9 with O(1) lattice and diagonal corrections. The exact theorem has no finite-range step. Full literal-factor tests passed for 3375 triples plus 240 long random cases, and thirteen independent finite means were checked.
